settings.question: What blank hoodies are best for wholesale?
settings.answer: Midweight pullover fleece hoodies are the wholesale standard. The cotton/poly fleece is warm and structured, the flat pullover front gives the most room for a screen-printed or embroidered design, and buying blanks by the pack keeps the per-unit cost low for full runs of retail, spirit wear, or staff hoodies.

settings.question: Pullover or zip-up hoodie — which is better for printing?
settings.answer: Pullovers. A pullover gives you an uninterrupted front and back, so big front art and full-back prints lay flat with nothing to print around. A zipper splits the front, which limits placement and adds cost to decorate. Bayou stocks pullover hoodies and crewneck fleece by the pack.

settings.answer: No. Bayou Blanks sells blank hoodies by the pack — 4-pack, 6-pack, or 12-pack — with no minimum beyond a single pack and no account or resale certificate required. It's a flat $1.50 a unit, the same in every size and pack.

settings.question: Can you embroider a blank hoodie?
settings.answer: Yes — midweight, cotton-rich fleece is one of the better garments to embroider. It has enough body to prevent hoop marks and keep stitches sharp; use a cut-away backing for stability. A left-chest logo (about 3–4 inches) is the standard placement on a hoodie.

settings.question: What is the difference between a blank hoodie and a sweatshirt?
settings.answer: A hoodie has a hood and usually a front pocket; a crewneck sweatshirt is leaner, with no hood to print around, so it's cheaper to decorate. Both are midweight cotton/poly fleece and take the same screen print, embroidery, or DTF. Bayou stocks both, so pick the silhouette your design calls for.
